# Softwareaktierne rejser sig fra graven

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish episode of Store Penge (hosts Michael Bo Mortensen, Mikkel Rosenvold and Joachim Brygman of Pluto). It covers the strong US jobs report and the risk of rate hikes, the Norwegian oil fund selling down US Treasuries, and the rebound in software stocks. Joachim says he called the April bottom in SaaS stocks but now sees little upside left, and prefers AI stocks. Mikkel names Oracle (an indirect bet on OpenAI) and SailPoint (an all-or-nothing bet) as his current trades. The episode also discusses Bloom Energy joining the S&P 500 as a short-term index-flow trade, Danish pension funds underinvesting in scale-ups such as Flatpay, and US peace efforts in the Russia–Ukraine war.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ORCL — Oracle | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Indirect OpenAI bet; a high risk premium over OpenAI's capacity needs is priced in, and the story that OpenAI now leads may spread over the coming weeks.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel (guest) has put money into Oracle as an indirect way to own OpenAI, which cannot be bought directly. Much of Oracle's order backlog depends on OpenAI, and the market has priced in doubt about whether OpenAI will need all that capacity. With OpenAI's Astra model seen as retaking the lead from Anthropic, he expects sentiment to lift Oracle in the coming weeks. He says the view could change in 3-4 months if Anthropic releases something new.

#### Sell Triggers

- Anthropic releases a new model and retakes the lead
- Doubts about whether OpenAI needs the capacity grow again
- Weak earnings on Wednesday

> *"men du kan købe Oracle, som har en meget, meget stor del af deres ordre bundet op på OpenAI ... det tror jeg kan blive et godt bet i de kommende uger"*

---

### 🟢 SAIL — SailPoint | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Identity and permissions management for AI agents; binary case ahead of earnings. Loss-making, P/E 55-60, carries debt.

#### Reasoning

Mikkel (guest) calls it an all-or-nothing bet he has put a little money into. He argues that the layer between software and AI is where the winners are right now. The market is very unsure about its earnings, the company is not profitable, it has a high valuation, and its debt makes it vulnerable to a rate hike.

#### Sell Triggers

- Weak earnings report
- Central bank raises rates
- Earnings uncertainty is confirmed

> *"det er virkelig sådan en alt eller intet bet ... der er en lille virksomhed der hedder Sailpoint som laver sådan en identitetsstyring og rettighedsstyring til AI-agenter"*

---

### 🟡 CRM — Salesforce | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Joachim says SaaS stocks were oversold and have recovered about 50%, but little upside is left. The P/E is similar to Nvidia's with much lower growth.

#### Reasoning

Joachim (co-host) called the April bottom in SaaS stocks. Their enterprise foothold means their earnings were not hit, and Salesforce rose 17% on strong results. After the rally, he thinks there is not much upside left and sees more attractive places to put money, such as AI stocks, on valuation grounds.

#### Sell Triggers

- Valuation stays close to Nvidia's without matching growth
- AI starts to erode enterprise revenue

> *"så tror jeg ikke, at der er ret meget mere upside tilbage på de her SaaS-aktier"*

---

### 🟠 BE — Bloom Energy | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Joins the S&P 500 on 21 September; mechanical ETF buying is expected, followed by selling afterwards. A timing-dependent trade.

#### Reasoning

The hosts say index inclusion brings forced buying by ETFs up to rebalancing, though part of it is already priced in. They call it a timing trade, with selling likely after the inclusion date, and a good test case to follow day by day. This is not an explicit buy recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- After the index funds finish buying (around 21 September)
- Selling by speculators after inclusion

> *"men det er virkelig et timingsbill, det her"*

---
